chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) regarding martyrdom and piety, and it was said that he delivered it after the killing of Uthman at the beginning of his caliphate.

key_terms.عُثْمَانَ: Uthman ibn Affan, the third Caliph

ai.seo_question: What is the context and theme of Imam Ali's sermon on martyrdom and piety delivered after Uthman's death?
ai.summary: Delivered in the early years of Imam Ali’s caliphate following the assassination of Caliph Uthman, this sermon contextualizes martyrdom and piety within the turbulent political landscape of the Rashidun era. It highlights the transition from the stability of the Prophet’s time to the internal strife (fitna) that tested the community's spiritual resilience, emphasizing that true taqwa is the anchor in times of political upheaval.
